about: Window-relative points (physical pixels from the window's top-left corner, as in desktop_windows.py screenshots) where agent_message.py clicks each app's message box and checks it is empty. width is the window's outer width used to pick a layout. text is the area (left, top, right, bottom) that must hold no dark text; it starts just right of where the blinking text cursor sits. When an app update or a new layout moves these, re-measure as the LLM_Helpers README's agent_message.py section describes and update measured. Each composer layout under apps stays on one line so window sizes compare like table rows. The usage layouts keep named controls and crops on separate lines so an agent can find or update one entry directly.

usage.about: GPT-6.1-Sol mapped these usage controls from live captures on 2026-11-13 and Claude Code's 2026-11-10/11 test commands. Coordinates and crops are physical pixels relative to the outer window. A matching size is necessary, and the user must verify the named screen and panel state on a fresh capture before acting.
